subject: modificationindices doesn't work in an function

messages.author: 67ad126ac1f38b90
messages.subject: modificationindices doesn't work in an function
parts:
I wrote a SEM pipeline for our lab, with only model and dataset identified. The function modificationindices, however, failed to work in a function for no reason. It just never output any results. I hold an minimal example for display:

simeplecfa <- function(model, dataset){
     model.fit <- cfa(model = model, data = dataset) # fit CFA
     summary(model.fit, # output the result
          fit.measures = T,
          standardized = T)

     modificationindices(model.fit, minimum.value = 4, sort. = TRUE) %>%
          subset(., op == "=~") %>%
          knitr::kable(., format = "markdown")
}

The function modificationindices just doesn't work. Anyone who can help me solve the problem? Thanks!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: modificationindices doesn't work in an function
parts: The function modificationindices, however, failed to work in a function for no reason

You didn't clearly specify what you meant by "work".  Does modificationindices() return output when you call it without piping?  Always start small and build up from there.  My guess is that there was nothing to return because there were no modification indices > 4 (i.e., nothing met the criteria you set in your function).
